AANP-style FNP preparation

This simulator uses source-derived single-best-answer practice from the uploaded PDF. It is an independent study tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or presented as official AANP exam content. Exact and near-duplicate stems are removed, detected answer-leak items are excluded from exams, answer positions are balanced, and distractors are drawn from other answers in the same PDF section.
